data.name: Rail Capital
data.detailed_description:
Rail Capital is a real-time railway strategy and economic management game inspired by the Robber-Barons, shared networks, shifting ownership and decisions of 18xx board games.

Beginning in 1820 with little more than some cash and an ambitious plan, you'll found a railway, issue shares and raise the money needed to lay track, build trains and win important auctions of train prototypes, blueprints and company bonuses.

After laying track and designing services to decide exactly what each carriage should load, carry and unload you'll keep an eye on public and privately securable contracts, invest in prospective industries and place warehouses to gather the cargo.

Every railway exists within a wider economy. Passengers expect useful connections, industries buy raw materials, factories transform cargo into valuable products, and ports provide access to distant markets. Prices respond to supply and demand, while warehouses, contracts and specialist freight routes create opportunities for careful logistics planning.

Your company’s money is not your own. Revenue can be retained for expansion or paid as dividends to shareholders. Buy and sell shares, defend your presidency, challenge rival boards and pursue mergers. Prototype locomotives, blueprints and freight consignments also pass through live railway auctions.

Compete against distinct AI personalities or other players in real-time multiplayer games. Explore seeded sandbox maps, handcrafted scenarios, guided campaigns, daily challenges and the Iron Road rogue-lite mode, where your company advantages carry across a branching railway journey.

Watch the network come alive as trains climb hills, enter tunnels, cross rivers and steam between growing towns. Build an efficient railway, a powerful company and, ultimately, your own Rail Capital!

data.short_description: Build railway empires in real time. Lay tracks, run passenger and freight services, trade shares and even takeover rival companies - against your friends and/or with AI opponents. Features handcrafted scenarios, sequenced campaigns, Game of the Day, seeded maps and a rogue-lite game mode.
data.supported_languages: English, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, French, Italian, Spanish - Spain

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit processor with SSE4.2
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit processor with SSE4.2
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 400 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus / Apple M1 integrated graphics or equivalent
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or better / Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 or better / dedicated GPU with 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or equivalent 64-bit Linux
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 630 / AMD Vega 8 or equivalent, with OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:

  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS or equivalent 64-bit Linux
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
